item.title: 19-year-old killed in single-vehicle crash near Eldon
item.description: A 19-year-old man from Rocky Mount died in a single-vehicle crash in Miller County, according to the Missouri State Highway Patrol.

item.title: Fans mourn the death of beloved hippo Fiona at Cincinnati Zoo, express frustration over the tragedy
item.description: People across the globe are mourning the death of Fiona, a hippopotamus at Cincinnati Zoo who died after ingesting a hat that landed in her habitat.

item.title: Forecast: Expecting a BEAUTIFUL Saturday before a much more seasonal week ahead
item.description: Warm and sunny conditions both today and tomorrow before we expect a pretty major cool down looking into next week.

item.title: Owensville man dead after truck goes airborne, strikes tree in Crawford County
item.description: An Owensville man, 32, died after his pickup left Highway 8 near Steelville at 4:19 a.m., went airborne and hit a tree, MSHP says. He was taken to a hospital but later died. No seatbelt was worn.

item.title: Rocky Mount, Mo. teen dead after Miller County vehicle crash
item.description: A 19-year-old Rocky Mount teen died in a Friday morning crash on Route Y in Miller County, MSHP says. His BMW skidded off the road, hit debris, went airborne, and struck a tree.

item.title: Cutting down the thorny barrier to lower prescription drug prices
item.description: We’re urging Sen. Hawley’s colleagues to follow his lead on healthcare prices and vote for his bill.

item.title: The politics of decency start with new Democrat-elect representatives in Congress
item.description: Adam Hamilton, the new senator from Kansas, is not just expressing a political impulse for bipartisanship, but a religious one as well.
